pack.title: Glimpse Alpha V2.4.5
pack.summary: Release V2.4.5. 4 change(s) in this update - see the full changelog on the Wiki for details.

launcher.notes: Fixes a bug in 1.0.0 where clicking Update could report success without actually replacing the mod files in your pack's mods folder. Update now verifies the files it placed are really on disk before reporting success, and removes old version-stamped mod jars that a new version replaces. Also includes a redesigned Home/Settings/Log interface. If your pack folder was last updated by 1.0.0, the first update on 1.1.0 may leave one old-versioned jar behind for one cycle — see the launcher guide's "Confirming an update actually applied" section.
